policy: The owner directed Hunt to show product photos again, including LEGO, Nike, Apple, Nintendo, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana, Mattel, and first-party photos/ files. A card shows a photo when the src is a web address or a photos/ or images/ file, and the src is not empty and not a brand logo. Cards with no photo use a category icon. The photos added for the former icon rows are optimized WebP files in images/. Each one is listed below with alt text and a source.

licenses.terms: TCGplayer API Terms allow an application to display content the API makes available. The app must say it uses TCGplayer data and is not endorsed or certified by TCGplayer, and it must link to the product page. Hunt hotlinks tcgplayer-cdn.tcgplayer.com and does not rehost the files.

Scryfall publishes Magic imagery for Magic software under its API image guidelines and the Wizards of the Coast Fan Content Policy. Hunt hotlinks the Scryfall URL, does not rehost it, and does not crop, recolor, or watermark it.
Scrydex best practices allow an application to show card images from the image URLs the API returns. Scrydex does not own the photographs. Hunt does not show logo URLs from this host.
